entities.summary: The First National Bank (FNB) Stadium, also known as Soccer City or the Calabash, is a soccer and rugby stadium located in Nasrec, bordering the Soweto area of Johannesburg, South Africa. The site is managed by Stadium Management South Africa (SMSA) and is home of Kaizer Chiefs F.C. in the South African Premier Soccer League as well as the venue for key fixtures for the South Africa national football team.
